newsitem.title: USA: US spot natgas up amid stock refills, firm futures.
newsitem.headline: US spot natgas up amid stock refills, firm futures.

text.p: U.S. spot natgas prices were mostly higher Tuesday, boosted by a strong storage demand in the U.S. producing region, market sources said.

"There's a lot of demand not because of weather but because of storage injections. Also, a lot of people apparently went into the market short," one Texas-based source said, noting most buyers were in central-south Texas where inventories were at their lowest and air-conditioning demand was imminent.
Louisiana Gulf Coast prices rose by about nine cents to the mid-$1.80s, with Henry Hub quoted mostly at $1.85-1.88.
In south Texas, prices were equally higher in the high-$1.70s to low-$1.80s.
In congruence with cash, NYMEX's Henry Hub April gas futures as of 1311 EST were up 11.7 cents at $1.92.
In the East, swing prices in the Appalachian region were slightly higher in the $1.87-1.94 area on Columbia Gas and in the mid-to-high $1.90s on CNG.
At the New York city-gate, prices were steady to higher in the $2.08-2.13 area, but mild weather forecasts and ample storage supplies put a lid on demand.
In the Midcontinent, where temperatures near the Great Lakes states are forecast to dip to below-normal levels Wednesday, prices climbed more than five cents higher to the low-to-mid $1.70s.
Chicago city-gate values were also talked higher in the low-to-mid $1.90s.
Sources also attributed the price uptick to storage injections and aftermarket demand.
In the Permian basin, gas prices were up about 10 cents to an average range of $1.71-1.76.
At Waha, prices were talked in the mid-to-high $1.70s, while southern California border prices jumped into the mid-$1.80s, up nearly 20 cents.

Helping to boost West Coast prices, traders said, was news that the 1,070 megawatt San Onofre 2 nuclear unit in southern California would not restart Friday as scheduled. The Nuclear Regulatory Commission said the unit would likely restart around March 12 following repairs of a leak.
